categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou S.P.I Design Co., Ltd. primarily operates in landscape design, architectural design, and garden greening engineering general contracting (EPC). The company offers comprehensive solutions including spatial planning, commercial planning, architectural and interior design, serving government, real estate developers, and urban renewal projects. It also develops digital technology products and investment businesses related to its core design services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages innovative design methodologies such as the proprietary 'New Landscape' design theory, BIM (Building Information Modeling), AI, VR, and parametric design technologies. It integrates digital landscape design software, intelligent design algorithms, and 3D modeling tools to enhance design efficiency and precision. EPC projects are managed with a full lifecycle approach including design, procurement, construction, and operation, supported by digital management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major real estate developers like Poly, China Resources Land, China Merchants Shekou, Longfor, China Railway, and government entities. The company serves markets in urban development, community landscaping, cultural tourism, commercial spaces, and municipal public projects. Its services target urban renewal, rural revitalization, and ecological restoration sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with branches in 19 major cities including Guangzhou (headquarters), Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Kunming, Changsha, Wuhan, Chongqing, Chengdu, Nanjing, Zhengzhou, Ding'an, Hefei, and Tianjin. It also has subsidiaries in Hainan and Hong Kong, indicating a broad national and partial international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou S.P.I Design Co., Ltd. operates primarily upstream and midstream in the construction and urban development supply chain, focusing on design and engineering services. It extends downstream through EPC general contracting, integrating design with procurement, construction, and operation management, thus covering a comprehensive segment of the project lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment in AI-enabled design tools, digital landscape platforms, and smart construction management systems. Strategic priorities include advancing digital transformation, expanding 'design+' integrated services, and developing EPC capabilities. It also focuses on sustainable design, green building standards, and smart city technologies aligned with national policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through design service fees based on contract stages and EPC project contracting fees. The company secures clients via direct commissions and competitive bidding. Additional income streams include leasing and investment returns. The business model emphasizes phased delivery of design outputs and comprehensive project lifecycle management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading large-scale, nationwide integrated design firm in the landscape and architectural design industry. It holds top industry rankings and multiple prestigious awards, distinguishing itself through innovation, comprehensive service offerings, and strong client relationships. Competitors include other professional design and EPC firms in China, but S.P.I maintains a competitive edge through its technology integration and broad geographic footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 459 million, a 37.84% increase from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 28.6 million, reversing prior losses. Total assets reached about RMB 943 million with steady growth. The company has over 1,000 employees and continues to expand its market presence and service capabilities, reflecting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by providing high-quality, innovative, and sustainable design solutions that integrate art, science, and ecology. Its proprietary 'New Landscape' methodology and advanced digital tools enhance design creativity and efficiency. The full lifecycle EPC+F+O service model offers clients seamless integration from design through financing, construction, and operation, delivering comprehensive value and enabling clients to achieve premium product and brand differentiation.
